claims.text: The hotel opened as the Olympic Hotel in 1924.
Pike Place Market is a five-minute walk from the hotel.

findings.quote: Pike Place Market is a five-minute walk

claims.text: A 2021 renovation overseen by a Spanish design firm gave the landmark a more contemporary look with warmer lighting.

findings.quote: The most significant transformation came in 2021, when Spanish design firm Lázaro Rosa‑Violán oversaw a renovation that preserved the landmark’s architectural soul and gave it a cleaner, more contemporary edge, with warmer lighting

claims.text: The George serves a seafood-forward menu with local oysters, Dungeness crab, fresh-caught salmon and steak frites.

claims.text: Afternoon tea is served at Olympic Bar, in the hotel's main lobby and lounge.

claims.text: The hotel has an indoor heated pool on the second floor.
